title: Merchandise – pins
slide_intent: Teach designers how to preserve recognition on a small round object whose surface can accommodate only one device.
strategic_value: The circular Sheffield Museums seal can take the shape of the object itself, allowing color variation across a souvenir series.
demonstration: Overlapping pins carry the same seal. A white mark appears on black and dark marks appear on yellow, turquoise and pink.
practical_value: Change the pin ground and select a contrasting mark while keeping its circular form and lettering consistent.

content_islands.name: Pin assortment
content_islands.spec: Cluster the round objects in an overlapping vertical group within a white field.

content_islands.name: Seal impression
content_islands.spec: Fill each pin face with one seal. Preserve a clear border around the lettering and enough contrast to see the central line device.
